notes: Author's %medalswon(ctry_cd) macro, verbatim: PROC SQL SELECTs the country name for an IOC code INTO a macro variable, then PROC FREQ cross-tabulates sport*gender (WHERE country_code, BY country_code, /nosparse) for that country; invoked with USA and AUS under OPTIONS MPRINT. The only adaptation makes the bundle self-contained: the repo's Oracle->SAS Studio step read SAS/Olym_medals2.csv via PROC IMPORT from an absolute SAS Studio path (/home/u63413844/DataAnalysis), so that load is replaced by an inline DATA step whose DATALINES are a curated 41-row extract of the repo's own SAS/Olym_medals2.csv (USA & AUS across Aquatics/Athletics/Basketball/Rowing/Gymnastics/Softball, plus a few CHN/GBR rows). Macro logic, PROC SQL, and PROC FREQ options are unchanged; %medalswon(USA)->United States and %medalswon(AUS)->Australia both resolve and print the sport-by-gender table.
